name: Empathy
overview: Scripture reveals empathy as a Christlike expression of love, commanding believers to treat others as they would want to be treated and to love one another as Christ loved us. Jesus' own sorrow at others' suffering models a deep compassion that moves us to rejoice with those who rejoice and weep with those who weep. Bearing one another's burdens fulfills the law of Christ, while our words should build up and minister grace, reflecting the heart of empathy in our relationships.
